name: msrelapse
description: A reference implementation of the Bordi et al. 2013 stochastic double well model of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: the asymmetric potential, the stochastic equation of motion, the mean exit time estimators, the duration fits, the relapse rate statistics and a virtual cohort generator.

referencePublication.name: A mechanistic, stochastic model helps understand multiple sclerosis course and pathogenesis

comment: The software is deposited in no archive and has no identifier of its own, which is why the identifier field is absent rather than empty: the reference to cite is the article in referencePublication, and CITATION.cff carries no identifier either. The author's ORCID belongs on the author entry above as "@id" once it is to hand. "datePublished" is the release date CITATION.cff carries as "date-released", so the two are set together, and "dateModified" is the date of the last change to the software.
